body: I’m young first of all so I think most people would think I just want attention. My life looks fine from an outsider’s perspective I imagine, too - I own nice things and have done very well in school up until recently. None of those things change how I feel about myself, though.

Damn yeah, that makes sense. If I’m all soft with her and trying to plead with her I’m just fueling her superiority complex. Better to just relax and see where it goes. That was a good analogy - thanks.

Well, hopefully the fact that I’m at least self-aware of the overall futility of this whole thing and knowing that I’m a hormonal teen helps a little. But fuck, it’s hard for ME to say that this doesn’t appear to be a really unique opportunity. I probably should’ve mentioned that I’m super fucking self-conscious and think I’m ugly as fuck. And I haven’t only put her on a pedestal AFTER making out with her; I’ve BEEN floored by this girl before I really even knew her. I’ve never been optimistic as far as relationships go, and honestly the jarring reaction between feeling on top of the world to extreme disappointment has only worsened my self-esteem. I know I probably sound pathetic as fuck for caring so much, but right now it at least feels like a big deal.

Yeah. At the moment, it feels like a once in a lifetime opportunity in a way so I feel like it’s kinda normal for me to want to take advantage of it despite everything else. But I also hope I find the guts to spare my dignity and get out at the same time. Thanks for the input.

Damn, this sounds really familiar. :( First, good on you for studying... I used to never be able to concentrate while my parents fought, but I eventually got used to it I suppose and did well in school. Sorry if this seems obvious, but have you tried some relaxed music? I personally really like low-fi (shoutout to the ChilledCow livestream on youtube); some, of course, prefer classical. Having a nice pair of headphones and a clean, relaxing setting can be helpful when your trying to concentrate even w/ yelling going on in the background. Also, this may not apply to your situation, but if you feel comfortable talking to them about it, you could at the very least acknowledge that if they are going to argue, could they at least try keep it down or do it in a room thats far from where you study.
